headline: Khaitan & Co guides London School of Business & Finance into India
sum: Khaitan & Co advised the London School of Business & Finance (LSBF) on the education regulatory aspects of its entry into the Indian market, including the structuring of its proposed education offerings. The transaction team consisted of…
detail: Khaitan & Co advised the London School of Business & Finance (LSBF) on the education regulatory aspects of its entry into the Indian market, including the structuring of its proposed education offerings. The transaction team consisted of Monika Srivastava (Partner), Sanchit Agarwal (Partner) and Romit Kohli (Senior Associate). Monika Srivastava, Sanchit Agarwal Also Read UK Universities York, Liverpool, Bristol to open India Campuses; CMS INDUSLAW Advises
